facts.fact: CPJ describes Mali's 2019 cybercrime law, applied by a cybercrime unit set up in 2022, as the law under which journalists are prosecuted.
CPJ reports the National Cybercrime Unit ordered the arrest of journalist Chahana Takiou on 8 June 2026 and detained Abdrahamane Keita on 9 June, both held under the cybercrime law.
